title: Defect Report Template
description:
Create `templates/defect-report.md`, the structured template users fill out before running `speed defect`. The template must include all fields that `parse_defect_report()` (Task 1) expects to extract, with inline guidance for each field.

**Template structure:**

```markdown
# Defect: <title>

Severity: <P0 | P1 | P2 | P3>
Related Feature: <feature-name matching a spec in specs/product/>

## Observed Behavior
<What actually happens. Be specific: include error messages, wrong values, broken UI states.>

## Expected Behavior
<What should happen instead, per the spec or reasonable user expectation.>

## Reproduction Steps
<Numbered steps to trigger the bug. Include preconditions (user state, data setup).>

## Additional Context (optional)
<Screenshots, log snippets, environment details, frequency of occurrence.>
```

Severity guide (as a comment block at the top of the template):
- P0: System down or data loss. Blocks all users.
- P1: Major feature broken. Workaround exists but painful.
- P2: Feature partially broken. Minor impact or edge case.
- P3: Cosmetic or minor inconvenience. No functional impact.

The template should also include a brief comment explaining that `Related Feature` must match a spec filename in `specs/product/` (without the .md extension).
acceptance_criteria:
- `templates/defect-report.md` exists [verify_by: file_exists]
- Template contains `Severity:` field with P0-P3 options documented [verify_by: test]
- Template contains `Related Feature:` field [verify_by: test]
- Template contains `## Observed Behavior` section [verify_by: test]
- Template contains `## Expected Behavior` section [verify_by: test]
- Template contains `## Reproduction Steps` section [verify_by: test]
- Template includes severity level descriptions (P0 through P3) [verify_by: test]

decisions: Added numbered example steps (1. Step 1, 2. Step 2, 3. Bug manifests) under Reproduction Steps to give users a concrete scaffold to fill in rather than just a placeholder comment.
Used an HTML comment block for the severity guide and Related Feature instructions so the guidance appears in the raw template but does not render in the filed report.
